Sharing the integration details, in case helpful. FitXpress runs as a white-label API and SDK inside an existing app, and a typical basic integration takes 2-4 weeks.

We support HIPAA-governed deployments under a BAA, encrypt data in transit and at rest, and delete photos after processing or within 30 days. The data-handling FAQ: https://3dlook.ai/content-hub/fitxpress-data-privacy-security-regulatory-faq/

Worth 15 min on the data flow? https://meetings.hubspot.com/nick-omelchak

Nick
